cards.text: Jesus is on the cross at Golgotha (Matthew 27:33-35). The chief priests mock Him, people passing by heap abuse on Him, and even the two robbers beside Him berate Him (Matthew 27:39-44). Then, at the sixth hour, darkness comes.

cards.question: The darkness that comes at the sixth hour covers only Golgotha, where Jesus is crucified.

cards.text: The darkness lasts until the ninth hour. About the ninth hour, Jesus cries out in a loud voice, "Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?" which means, "My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?"

cards.question: Some of the people standing by the cross hear Jesus cry "Eli, Eli" and say He is calling ___.

cards.text: Elijah, the prophet from long ago (1 Kings 18:36). Then one of the people standing there quickly runs, fills a sponge with sour wine and puts it on a reed.

cards.question: A man at the cross has a sponge full of sour wine on a reed. What does he do with it?

answers.text: Holds it up for Jesus to drink
Hands it over to the soldiers
Sets it down beside the cross

cards.text: But the others standing there say, "Leave Him alone."

cards.question: The others at the cross say, "Leave Him alone." What do they say they want to see?

answers.text: If Elijah comes to save Him

cards.text: Jesus cries out again in a loud voice, and He yields up His spirit. At that moment, the veil of the temple is torn in two from top to bottom.

cards.question: At the moment Jesus yields up His spirit, the earth ___, and the rocks are split.
As the earth quakes, the tombs break open. What happens to the bodies of many saints who had fallen asleep?

cards.text: Matthew says that after Jesus' resurrection, when they had come out of the tombs, these saints enter the holy city.

cards.question: The saints who were raised appear to many people in the holy city.

cards.text: Back at the cross, a centurion, a Roman officer, and the men with him guarding Jesus see the earthquake and all that has happened.

cards.question: When they see the earthquake and all that has happened, the centurion and those guarding Jesus with him are ___.
Terrified, the centurion and those with him say something about Jesus. What do they say?

answers.text: Truly this was the Son of God
Truly this was a great prophet
Truly this was the King of Israel

cards.text: And many women are there too, watching from a distance. They had followed Jesus all the way from Galilee.

cards.question: Many women watch the cross from a distance. Why had they followed Jesus from Galilee?

cards.text: Among them are Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of Zebedee's sons, the apostles James and John (Matthew 10:2). We'll stop here for now, friend, but this story is NOT over.
